has: Draft the changelog for the March release.
Breadcrumbs for deep landing pages. Readers landing on deep pages could not find their way up. Every page now shows breadcrumbs to its section.
Search ranking boosts titles. Matches in page titles were ranked like matches in body text, burying the obvious page. Weight title matches higher.
Timezones in feed timestamps. The RSS feed showed posts dated the day before for readers east of UTC. Always render feed timestamps in UTC with an explicit offset.
Rendering pages in a headless browser. Server-side rendering through a headless browser was tried for diagrams and dropped: startup cost per page was over a second.
Versioned documentation keeps three releases. The documentation site keeps the three most recent releases online; older versions are archived as downloadable bundles.
Build output must be reproducible. Two builds of the same commit differed because of embedded timestamps and random asset hashes. Derive both from the content.
Minimum supported reading width is 320 pixels. Layouts must work at 320 pixels wide without horizontal scrolling.
Sitemap must exclude drafts. Draft pages leaked into the sitemap and were indexed by search engines. Filter drafts before writing sitemap.xml.
Most build time is spent in image processing. Profiling three builds suggests image resizing accounts for most of the wall-clock time; content parsing is minor.
Content licence is CC BY 4.0. Documentation text is published under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; code samples under the project's software licence.
Hot reload drops scroll position. Every preview reload jumped to the top of the page. Preserve the scroll position across reloads.
Release notes are generated from labels. Hand-written release notes missed changes. Generate them from pull request labels and edit afterwards.
Dark mode images need transparent backgrounds. Diagrams with white backgrounds glared in dark mode. Export diagrams with transparent backgrounds and theme-aware strokes.
Revisit the snapshot tests on the slow runners before the March release.
Mermaid diagrams render at build time. Client-side diagram rendering shifted the page layout. Render diagrams to SVG during the build.
Fonts are self-hosted. Web fonts are bundled and served from our own origin, not a third-party CDN, for privacy and offline builds.
Make the link checker follow redirects so a 404 behind one shows.
Check the sitemap for draft pages.
Ask whether tracking scripts belong on the site at all.
Locale-aware sorting of the glossary page. The glossary sorted Cyrillic terms after all Latin ones in byte order. Use a collation for the page's locale.
Config validation fails fast. A typo in the site configuration silently disabled the sitemap. Validate configuration against a schema and stop on unknown keys.
Parallel image processing with a worker pool. Resizing images on a bounded worker pool cut build time by half without exhausting memory.
Large tables slow the PDF export. Exporting a page with a two-thousand-row table took minutes. Paginate tables before the PDF renderer sees them.
Emoji shortcodes break in headings. Emoji shortcodes in headings produced broken anchor ids. Strip emoji when generating anchors.
Contributor guide must mention the preview command. New writers did not know how to preview their changes. The contributor guide now starts with the preview command.
Retry uploads to object storage with jitter. Uploading thousands of assets at once hit the storage rate limit. Retry with exponential backoff and random jitter.
Image thumbnails need a size ceiling. A 40 megapixel photograph exhausted worker memory while generating thumbnails. Reject inputs above a pixel ceiling before decoding.
Footnote numbering restarts per page. Footnotes were numbered across the whole book, confusing readers of single pages. Number footnotes per page.
Link checker must respect rate limits. Checking external links hammered small sites and got our runner blocked. Limit requests per host and cache results for a day.
Readers mostly arrive from search. Referrer logs suggest about two thirds of readers land from a search engine on a deep page, not the home page.
Slow builds discourage small fixes. Writers batch small typo fixes when a build takes more than a few minutes; the number of tiny pull requests fell as builds slowed.
Unicode normalisation of file names. Pages whose file names were typed on different systems collided or went missing. Normalise file names to NFC before routing.
Try streaming the rows when a pdf export of a big table is slow.
The release notes say to rebuild the search index before a deploy.
Deploys go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Production deploys are scheduled for Tuesday and Thursday mornings so someone is around to watch the dashboards.
Thumbnails of a huge photo may need a memory limit on the worker.
A ticket asks to move production deploys to Wednesday mornings.
Code block highlighting needs a language fallback. Unknown language names in fenced code blocks crashed the highlighter. Fall back to plain text.
Translation files drift from the source. Translated pages fell behind the English source without anyone noticing. Record the source revision in each translation and flag stale ones.
Incremental builds miss template changes. Changing a layout template did not rebuild pages that used it. The dependency graph must include templates, not only content files.
Check the sitemap for draft pages once the config typo is fixed.
Embedded videos load lazily. Pages with several embedded videos loaded megabytes before the reader scrolled. Load video players only when visible.
Redirect map for moved pages. Moving pages between sections broke inbound links. Keep a redirect map and generate redirects on every build.
Flaky snapshot tests come from unsorted maps. Snapshot tests failed on one runner in five because map iteration order leaked into the rendered output. Sort keys before rendering.
One giant CSS bundle. A single stylesheet for every page type was rejected: it grew past 400 kilobytes and blocked first paint.
Spell checker dictionary per language. Russian pages produced hundreds of false spelling errors under the English dictionary. Choose the dictionary from the page's language tag.
Old deploy schedule caused weekend incidents. Friday deploys led to incidents nobody could watch over the weekend.
replaced by the Tuesday and Thursday schedule
Tell the reader in Asia once the feed dates are fixed.
Very long words overflow on phones. Long identifiers in prose overflowed the screen on narrow phones. Allow breaking long words in body text.
Math formulas render at build time. Client-side math rendering made pages jump as formulas loaded. Render formulas to markup during the build.
Watch mode leaks file handles. The file watcher opened a handle per directory and hit the operating system limit on large sites. Watch the root recursively instead.
Translations should catch up with the english source by spring.
Git history dates for last-modified. File system modification times were reset by checkout, so every page claimed to be updated today. Read the last commit date from git history instead.
Cold cache doubles the pipeline time. When the dependency cache misses, the CI pipeline takes about twice as long. Restore the cache before compiling, keyed on the lockfile hash.
Alt text is required on every image. Images without alternative text were invisible to screen reader users. The build now refuses an image without alt text.
Search index size must be split by section. The client-side search index grew to eight megabytes. Split it by section and load only what the reader searches.
Search index rebuild must be atomic. Readers saw a half-built search index during deploys. Build into a fresh directory and swap a symlink when complete.
Cross-version links need canonical URLs. Search engines indexed old documentation versions over the current one. Every versioned page declares the latest version as canonical.
Auto-translating pages with a model. Machine translation of whole pages was rejected: reviewers could not keep up and errors shipped silently.
Check the dependency cache hit rate once the pipeline change lands.
Heading anchors must be stable. Renaming a heading broke every external link to its anchor. Allow an explicit anchor id that survives renames.
Preview server must not cache drafts. Authors saw stale drafts in the preview server because responses were cached. Disable caching for preview responses.
Table of contents depth is three levels. Deep tables of contents overwhelmed the sidebar. Show headings down to level three only.
Broken internal links hide behind redirects. The link checker reported success on links that redirected to a 404 page. Follow redirects and check the final status.
No tracking scripts. The site ships no third-party tracking scripts; analytics come from server logs only.
Accessibility checks run in CI. Every pull request runs an automated accessibility audit; contrast and missing alt text fail the build.
Code samples are tested. Code samples in the guides drifted from the real API. Extract samples and run them as tests in CI.
Storing rendered pages in the database. Keeping rendered HTML in a database for faster rebuilds was rejected; invalidation was harder than rebuilding.
Most broken links are external. Two months of link checker reports suggest nine in ten broken links point to external sites, not our own pages.
Print stylesheet hides navigation. Printed pages wasted the first sheet on menus. A print stylesheet hides navigation and expands links.
Search runs client-side from a prebuilt index. Site search runs in the browser against an index generated at build time; there is no search server.
Markdown parser is the CommonMark reference. We parse markdown with a CommonMark-compliant parser and reject extensions that change block structure.
